notes: The prompt calls itself a survival game with one tagger and everyone else hiding, which is precisely the 1 vs All asymmetric case where one player is it, so Survival leads even though the terrain is an obby. Obby & Platformer is named second because the obstacle sections are the whole map and its jump and moving-obstacle options are the only way to express a hard course; it does not lead, so it does not drag its genre-wide P6 along, though warren-looping carries P6 on its own. The user answered the shape question directly by asking for an open warren of obstacle sections players can double back through while chased, which also rules out path-track and its single ordered route. I dropped gate-escape because the answer says hiders win by outlasting a timer, and I left checkpoints out since a timed tag round has no course progress to save; the bright stylized look came from the theme answer.
